name: Murderer I'd Like to Find
source:
Your father has been murdered. Reunite with your family, but stay cautious--there's a killer amongst them.

[From [url=https://bejules.itch.io/murderer-id-like-to-find]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的父親被謀殺了。與家人重聚，但務必保持警惕——兇手就在他們之中。

[摘自[url=https://bejules.itch.io/murderer-id-like-to-find]itch.io[/url]]
